references.phrase: after an arrow j→k, u and v become equal
references.disposition: The specified equalization of parallel arrows is a separate requirement from a common upper object; all three axioms are present.

review_rationale: Read the three defining conditions of a filtered category: nonemptiness, common targets of pairs of objects, and eventual equalization of parallel arrows. This is not just a directed preorder, although directed preorders are special cases.
